shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | head -100

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C4 "i18n\|configure\|lang" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json | grep -E '"version"|"main"|"types"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build 2>&1 | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; grep -rn "export.*configure\|Lang\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts; (curl -s -m 15 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/i18n/llms.txt | head -80)
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md | head -150; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -name "configure*.d.ts" | head;

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "i18n" package-lock.json | head -5; grep -n "useLang\|ThemeProvider.*lang\|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/*.d.ts | head; cat tsconfig.json

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit RadioButton Select Flex Text Card Pagination 2>&1 | head -50; npm install --save-exact=false @gravity-ui/i18n@^1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -5; grep -n i18n package.json

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit RadioButton Select Flex Text Card Pagination 2>&1 | head -50; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/RadioButton/RadioButton.d.ts | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts | head -40

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | tr '\n' ' '; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/RadioButton node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination; grep -rn "DialogProps\|interface DialogOwnProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts | head -3

cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls SegmentedRadioGroup; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; cat Pagination/types.d.ts | head -50; ls Pagination/i18n
